structured_output.what_is_happening: Pump.fun coin "Wojak Accelerationism" (woj/acc), a Wojak twist on the e/acc "accelerationism" meme format. Its PumpSwap pool opened at 10:07Z, and the packet's created and migrated timestamps are the same second. In about 15 minutes it went up roughly 470% to about $296k market cap. That is $856k of volume on $50k liquidity, 1,356 unique buyers against 727 sellers, and 1,663 holders. It already touched an ATH near $408k (per the GMGN ath_price) and has pulled back about 27%. I found no organic discussion on the web. The only footprint is the project's own landing site and the X handle @wojaccsolana.

narrative.description: Wojak plus 'X/acc' accelerationism meme branding ('born to wojak. forced to accelerate', 'NO BRAKES, ONLY FORWARD'). It is a generic culture meme, not tied to any current news event. Wojak political-compass accelerationism memes have circulated since around 2020 (KYM).
narrative.why_spreading: Nothing external found. The spread looks driven by on-chain momentum and trenches traders chasing a fast graduation, plus the familiar Wojak plus /acc meme format, rather than any catalyst.

token_connection.why_this_token: It has its own website and X handle, and all the volume is here. The only same-name token (2RRz..., 'wojacc') launched about 75 minutes earlier and is dead ($3.6k market cap, zero liquidity).

authenticity.evidence: On the positive side: 1,356 unique buyers, 1,663 holders, top-10 holders at only 11.7%, dev holds 0.07%, no paid DexScreener boosts or ads, and 7 smart wallets. On the negative side: GMGN tags 778 fresh wallets and 220 bundler wallets (top bundler trader share about 10%), plus 36 snipers. I found no organic posts on X, Reddit or Telegram. The dev is funded from KuCoin, has launched only this one token, and the dev's X account has launched 2 tokens.
authenticity.uncertainty: Search engines don't index X in real time, so I can't see whether call channels or KOLs are driving the flow.

structural_risks: Entry comes after about 5x in 15 minutes and roughly 27% below the ATH, so there is heavy early-holder profit overhang
About 220 bundler wallets and 778 fresh wallets could dump together
$50k liquidity against $296k market cap: a -50% move is easy to hit on a volatile unwind
LP is 100% burned and mint and freeze authority are renounced, so a classic LP pull is unlikely

structured_output.counterargument: The distribution is healthy (low top-10, dev holds almost nothing, LP burned), the buyer count is large and growing, and buys still outnumber sells. Graduated coins with this much velocity and a clean meme sometimes run from $300k to $1M+ as they reach DexScreener trending. On the other side, the chart may already have peaked at $408k. Fresh and bundler wallets may make up much of the 'demand', and without an external catalyst a -50% retrace in the first hour is the most common path.
unknowns: Actual X activity around @wojaccsolana and any KOL or call-channel pushes
Whether bundler wallets have already sold
What the dev's X account launched before
Order flow in the 3 minutes before entry

source_coverage.notes: Contract, name and ticker searches returned nothing relevant. The project site is a bare landing page linking to X, pump.fun and FOMO.family.

structured_output.thesis: A high-velocity, freshly migrated meme with a clean structure (burned LP, dispersed holders, dev out) but no visible external narrative, and heavy fresh and bundler participation. Momentum and buyer breadth put it somewhat above the base rate, but entering after a 5x, below the ATH, makes a -50% stop about as likely as a 2x.
